incidents.summary: Hosted CI pre-allocation failures were caused by exhausted private-repository Actions minutes; repository visibility later changed to public and runner allocation recovered.
Recovered full CI exposed 7 failures: stale/contradictory hot-path tests, stale readiness assertions, two authority-migration omissions and deprecated Actions runtime versions.
The object-store live probe depended on obsolete or unauthorized MinIO container distribution paths before the S3 adapter itself could execute.

root_cause.primary: Full repository CI was unavailable during prior promotions, so targeted evaluation passed while older full-suite contracts and callers drifted behind current authority semantics.
contributing: Two cutover tests encoded mutually incompatible migration-directory expectations.
AuthorityScopeGate migration did not update the isolated self-change drill and one legacy multifault test caller.
Readiness regression test asserted a retired phase-11 schema/status literally instead of current assurance invariants.
Core workflows still used Actions versions that GitHub now runs through a Node 20 compatibility/deprecation path.
Observation-only commits unnecessarily triggered the same full CI workflow.
The S3 protocol probe was coupled to a specific MinIO image distribution path even though ADR-026 intentionally targets the S3 protocol rather than a vendor.

changes: Migrate the self-change drill and multifault caller to explicit UAOS authority metadata.
Replace stale literal/path assertions with current .uaos binding and retired-migration invariants.
Make readiness tests validate assurance semantics rather than a retired exact status schema.
Remove predecessor-controller literal from README hot path and refresh requirement-authority documentation.
Upgrade checkout/setup-python Actions to current v7 majors.
Add workflow concurrency cancellation and skip redundant full CI for observation/readiness/README-only pushes while retaining PR/manual verification.
Exercise the S3 adapter through a registry-independent standalone HTTP S3 emulator while keeping production-provider assurance separate.
proposal.rollback_plan: If post-promotion evidence regresses, revert the single promotion commit and retain this evaluation record.

required: full pytest suite passes on GitHub-hosted runner
live integration PR jobs pass for PostgreSQL/DBOS and object-store paths
openai-provider live job remains intentionally manual and is not required for this patch because provider integration code is unchanged
candidate tree contains no new controller plane or runtime component

passing_evidence.postgres_dbos_job: PASS including contract suite, CAS/ledger, DBOS identity/idempotency, maintenance schedule and crash/recovery
passing_evidence.object_store_job: PASS via standalone HTTP S3 emulator with content-addressed roundtrip and cleanup
